textos.Parte deste grupo reclama que a narrativ: A portion of this group complains that the narrative takes a long time to get going and that certain stretches become repetitive or boring, making the film feel longer than it is.

textos.As reviews medianas reconhecem que o fil: Middling reviews acknowledge that the film offers reflections on control, freedom, surveillance and the manipulation of reality, but some feel these themes are not explored with the expected depth.
textos.O desfecho divide opiniões: alguns o con: The ending divides opinion: some consider it satisfying, while others feel the story ends abruptly or that a more surprising ending would have been more interesting.
textos.Várias pessoas comentam que criaram expe: Several people comment that they had very high expectations because of the film's fame and ended up disappointed, feeling it does not deserve all the hype it receives.

textos.O filme é visto como uma crítica à socie: The film is seen as a critique of the society of the spectacle, consumerism, mass surveillance and celebrity culture, proving more and more relevant.

textos.Lançado em 1998 e dirigido por Peter Wei: Released in 1998 and directed by Peter Weir, The Truman Show is a drama with touches of comedy about Truman Burbank, a mild-mannered insurance salesman who lives with his wife. Intrigued by unusual events around him and after meeting a mysterious woman, he begins to doubt his daily life and discovers that his whole life has been monitored and broadcast as a television spectacle.
textos.Na recepção do filme, os grupos avaliati: In the film's reception, the rating groups agree on what the film is and discuss the same themes, but disagree on whether it actually works. In the vast majority of ratings (~90%), a good portion highlight Jim Carrey's performance in both comedy and drama, while a significant share praise the social criticism aimed at surveillance and the society of the spectacle. In addition, a considerable number value the existential message about the pursuit of freedom and authenticity.
textos.Para quem se encontra numa fração mínima: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~9%), several point out that the initial concept outweighs how the execution is carried out, with many pointing to a slow, drawn-out pace. Even in this middle range, some positively highlight the lead's performance.
textos.Já para os registros situados numa fraçã: For the entries in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~1%), a good portion complain of an excessively slow pace that results in boredom, and several see the execution as disappointing given the premise's potential. Finally, a considerable number express frustration with the production's high reputation, considering the film overrated.
